title: AI and My Values: User Perceptions of LLMs’ Ability to Extract, Embody, and Explain Human Values from Casual Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating AI value alignment using Schwartz’s Theory of 19 human values, which includes 'Tradition' (respect for religious customs). It specifically investigates how LLMs extract and embody moral and ethical values, judging moral dilemmas like the trolley problem and assessing cultural value priorities.
